newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rebel mine kills six civilians.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rebel mine kills six civilians.

text.p: A land mine planted on an east Sri Lanka road by Tamil separatist guerrillas blew up a van on Tuesday killing six civilians, two of them children, military officials said.
The blast at the village of Kudapokuna in Polonnaruwa district, 200 km (125 miles) northeast of Colombo, wounded at least two passengers, they said.
Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam rebels, hiding in nearby jungle, opened fire at police, delaying the rescue of the wounded, they added.
The LTTE, who are fighting for a homeland for minority Tamils in the predominantly Sinhalese Indian Ocean island's north and east, were not immediately available for comment.
The government says more than 50,000 people have died in the war, now in its 14th year. The LTTE say the toll is higher.
